people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
translations.bsb: Then Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more.
translations.kjv: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
translations.asv: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
